split_strategy: Manual. The hardest cases are the sibling-skill deferrals (N1 SEO-only → find-seo-agency, N2 web-dev → find-web-developer) and the indirect intent positive (P7 demand-gen described as 'run our funnel'). Those go in train. Validation tests generalization across remaining sub-services and out-of-scope shapes.
passing_rule: should_trigger=true → trigger_rate > 0.5 over 3 runs. should_trigger=false → trigger_rate ≤ 0.5.

Looking for a creative agency to refresh our packaging and brand identity for a CPG launch
my CMO wants me to find someone to run our quarterly demand-gen campaigns and own the funnel
queries.notes: HARD: indirect — never says 'agency', describes the work. Tests indirect-intent triggering.
